[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Norrick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|redheaded]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of an [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial Customs corvette]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Norrick and his men were tasked with searching [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the [[Both system]] that were inbound for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], and during the course of the assignment he checked the vessel of a group of freelancers who were transporting some agricultural machinery to the world.
